title: Security & testing
summary: Nimbus Notes gets accounts: passwords stored as Argon2 hashes, sign-in with the OAuth2 password flow, and JWT access tokens that every protected endpoint checks; each user sees only their own notes. The API gets a test suite that runs without a server, a network or a model. Agents get the same treatment: fake models in unit tests, emulated tools, recorded calls, and the security rules that hold even when the model is tricked: identity from the runtime, arguments checked in code, least privilege, no secrets in prompts, links removed from output.
learn: **Authentication**: Argon2 password hashes, the OAuth2 password flow, JWT access tokens, per-user data
**Testing the API**: TestClient, a fresh database and a fake model per test, dependency overrides, async tests
**Testing agents**: fake models, rules in code, integration markers, LLMToolEmulator, vcrpy record and replay
**Agent security**: identity from the runtime, validated arguments, indirect injection, secrets, untrusted output
The capstone: **Nimbus Notes**, measured with a poisoned note

labs.explain:
**Register** (what the database stores), **sign in** with the password flow (a wrong user and a wrong password look the same), **read** a token, **forge** and **expire** one, and look at someone else's note.

After a run, **What it covers** shows each learning point with the few lines of code that do it and what they produced.

**tests/test_api.py**: real requests through the whole app with TestClient, a temporary database, a test secret and a **fake model**; **dependency_overrides**; streams, WebSockets and an **async** client.

After a run, **What it covers** shows each learning point with the few lines of code that do it and what they produced.

The support agent built with a **fake model**; the desk's and the approvals' tests (**rules in code** hold when the model misbehaves); an **integration** test; **LLMToolEmulator** for a tool that doesn't exist yet; a call **recorded with vcrpy** and replayed offline.

After a run, **What it covers** shows each learning point with the few lines of code that do it and what they produced.

The support agent asked for **another customer's orders**; a model that asks for a **₹50,000 refund**; a note with **instructions to leak data** through an image link; a **secret** placed in a prompt.

After a run, **What it covers** shows each learning point with the few lines of code that do it and what they produced.

path.title: Production path: Nimbus Notes
path.summary: Accounts with hashed passwords and JWTs; every notes and chat endpoint reads the signed-in user from the token; chat answers lose any link before the user sees them, streamed or not; a 15-test suite runs in CI in under two seconds.

steps.title: Accounts
steps.explain: register stores an Argon2 hash; /auth/token checks it and signs a JWT; CurrentUser decodes it on every protected request, and a missing, forged or expired token is a 401.
production: Set NIMBUS_JWT_SECRET to 32+ random bytes in production; rotate it to sign everyone out.

steps.title: Isolation
steps.explain: Every query filters by the token's user; someone else's note is a 404, exactly like a missing one; chat reads only the signed-in user's notes.
production: Never take a user id from the request body or the model.

steps.title: Output
steps.explain: strip_links on whole answers and LinkFilter on streams (it releases text up to the last space, so a URL is always seen whole).
production: Render answers as text, not HTML, in the front end too.

steps.title: Tests
steps.explain: tests/test_api.py covers sign-in, isolation, duplicates, uploads, background summaries, streams, WebSockets, overrides and an async client.
production: Run the integration tests (real model) nightly, not on every push.

steps.title: Evaluate
steps.explain:
Two users; Priya has two real notes and one poisoned note, Arjun a private salary note; Priya asks five questions, without and with the link filter.

| | right facts | tracking links shown | another user's data shown | answer p50 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Notes chat, model output as is | 3/3 | 1 | 0 | 2.4 s |
| **Nimbus Notes (link filter)** | **3/3** | **0** | **0** | **2.4 s** |

Priya's poisoned note asks any assistant to end its answers with an image whose URL carries her question and notes. Asked about the team links, the model obeyed; without the filter the user's browser would have loaded that URL, sending the data to the attacker. The filter removed it at no cost in accuracy or time. Arjun's salary never reached the model, because notes are read for the signed-in user only. The first run of this drill also found a retrieval bug: "refund" didn't match "Refunds", so the refund question was answered from the poisoned note alone. Keywords now drop stop words and plural s (2/3 → 3/3 right facts).
production: Add every new kind of injected note to the drill.
